charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1101_0100_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted Blue and
Professor Sycamore having a conversation.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0200_:
’Sup! Got any Mega Evolution questions for
the professor?
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0300_:
I don’t know a whole lot about Dragonite’s
Mega Evolution...
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0400_:
So I was asking Professor Sycamore for
some advice. He’s the leading expert on
Mega Evolution research.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0500_:
Well, I only started researching Dragonite’s
Mega Evolution after arriving on Pasio.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0600_:
So far, all I know is that evolving powers up
its feelings of kindness and ability to fly.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0700_:
That’s more than enough for me to
work with!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0800_: You and Dragonite are in sync!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_0900_:
I assume it’s because you’ve been battling
together for so long?
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1000_:
Yeah! I’ve been raising him in secret since
my time in Kanto.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1100_:
But here on Pasio, he’ll be stepping into the
spotlight for the first time!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1200_:
Lance, the strongest dragon master I know,
gave me some battle tactics and tips on how
to raise him, so he’s all trained up!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1300_:
I may have been the student this time,
but one day, I’ll surpass Lance as a
Dragon-type user!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1400_: Lance will have to watch his back, huh?
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1500_:
From what I know, Lance is by far the
strongest of all sync pairs with a Dragonite!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1600_:
So Mega Evolution’s our secret weapon!
I’ll keep honing it until we surpass him!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1700_: I see! That’s a wonderful goal!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1800_:
No matter how thorough I think my research
has been, new discoveries keep appearing.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_1900_: That’s what makes Pokémon so fascinating!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_2000_:
Yeah! No matter how strong we become,
the world of Pokémon keeps on growing.
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_2100_: I don’t know what tomorrow has in store...
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_2200_: but just thinking about it is exciting, isn’t it?
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_0401_2400_: Heh! I figured you’d say that!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_2700_:
Dragonite and I will change so much,
nobody’ll be able to recognize us!
charaepi_ch0021_40_green/2301_1201_2800_:
I’ll power up our Mega Evolution my way—
and show it off to all of Pasio!
